Wardenflame · overworld asset review

One card per shipped PNG, including animation strips, shadow/light masks, town attachments and map icons. Decisions follow the asset-by-asset visual review against the characters and Embers of the Vale lore.

Integration gap: Ashen Ford currently saves terrain and markers. Detailed props, buildings, effects and literal map-place overrides are library-ready; the walking renderer and authored placement layer are not implemented. Placement recommendations below are not live map changes. Gameplay heights, flags, battle stamps and painted region layouts are preserved.

terrain/grass/green

refined · top

Where it fits

Reduced grass tuft density and isolated white tips. Preserve broad colour masses; autumn/dry palettes carry the cooling land while green/lush remain near warm fields.

Current placement

627 tiles in saved regions; battle maps may also use it.
